verdict.rationale: Statsig ships an official MCP server that plugs into AI tools (Codex, Cursor, Claude Code) so users can 'ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI' — this is direct evidence of natural-language operation of the product via AI-native interfaces. However, the docs mostly emphasize read/explore use cases rather than confirming full natural-language control over write actions (creating gates, launching experiments, etc.), and there's no independent hands-on report confirming reliability of NL commands. Missing for 10: evidence of NL-driven write/mutation actions (not just querying), and independent/community validation of the MCP NL experience.
